patch.value: pm validate: --all-affected-ids flag + never truncate ID lists in JSON mode (GH-224)

Add --all-affected-ids so validate prints complete missing_* ID lists (grep-friendly), and ensure --json never truncates the *_item_ids arrays (drop the 5-item summary cap for JSON consumers). Keep human default truncation for readability.

pm validate --all-affected-ids shipped + JSON mode never truncates *_item_ids (fullDiagnostics = verbose||allAffectedIds||json). Verified human=5/truncated, --all-affected-ids/--json=full. Closes GH-224.
